title.narrative: Empowering Senegalese youth through urban arts and sports

description.narrative:
The initiative aims to empower Senegalese youth through a series of cultural, artistic and sports-related activities linked to URBANOIZ, the Dakar Biennale and the Youth Olympic Games 2026. The activities will support skills development, mentorship and professional exchange for young artists and cultural practitioners, while promoting inclusive participation of young people in cultural and sports events.
By strengthening local cultural production, professional networks and opportunities for creative entrepreneurship, the initiative contributes to improved employability, economic opportunities and social cohesion for young people in Dakar, thereby supporting sustainable development in Senegal.

To promote economic opportunities and social inclusion for young people in Dakar by strengthening skills development, creative entrepreneurship and access to cultural and sports activities, thereby contributing to social cohesion and sustainable livelihoods in Senegal.
